                "html_length": len(html_content)
            }
            
        except Exception as e:
            return {
                "report_generated": False,
                "error": str(e)
            }
    
    async def test_integration(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """测试系统集成 / Test system integration"""
        
        try:
            # 创建应用实例 / Create application instance
            app = DeepResearchApplication()
            
            # 初始化系统 / Initialize system
            init_success = await app.initialize_system()
            
            if not init_success:
                return {
                    "integration_success": False,
                    "error": "系统初始化失败"
                }
            
            # 运行简短研究 / Run short research
            result = await app.run_research(
                research_question="什么是云计算？",

                save_report=False  # 不保存文件以加快测试 / Don't save file to speed up test
            )
            
            return {
                "integration_success": True,
                "app_initialized": init_success,
                "research_completed": result.get('research_complete', False),
                "final_status": result.get('current_status', 'unknown'),
                "execution_time": result.get('total_execution_time', 0)
            }
            
        except Exception as e:
            return {
                "integration_success": False,
                "error": str(e)
            }
    
    async def test_performance(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """测试性能 / Test performance"""
        
        performance_results = {}
        
        # 测试搜索性能 / Test search performance
        start_time = time.time()
        search_results = search_func("性能测试")
        search_time = time.time() - start_time
        
        performance_results["search_time"] = search_time
        performance_results["search_results_count"] = len(search_results)
        
        # 测试模型性能 / Test model performance
        if hasattr(self, '_test_model_performance'):
            model_time = await self._test_model_performance()
            performance_results["model_response_time"] = model_time
        
        # 测试内存使用 / Test memory usage
        import psutil

        performance_results.update({
            "memory_rss_mb": memory_info.rss / 1024 / 1024,
            "memory_vms_mb": memory_info.vms / 1024 / 1024,
            "cpu_percent": process.cpu_percent()
        })
        
        return performance_results
    
    def generate_report(self) -> str:
        """
        生成测试报告
        Generate test report
        
        Returns:
            str: 测试报告文本 / Test report text

        report_lines = []
        
        # 报告头部 / Report header
        report_lines.append("=" * 60)
        report_lines.append("🧪 深度研究代理 - 系统测试报告")
        report_lines.append("Deep Research Agent - System Test Report")
        report_lines.append("=" * 60)
        report_lines.append("")
        
        # 测试总结 / Test summary
        report_lines.append("📊 测试总结 / Test Summary:")
        report_lines.append(f"   总测试数 / Total Tests: {self.total_tests}")
        report_lines.append(f"   通过测试 / Passed: {self.passed_tests}")
        report_lines.append(f"   失败测试 / Failed: {self.failed_tests}")
        
        success_rate = (self.passed_tests / self.total_tests * 100) if self.total_tests > 0 else 0
        report_lines.append(f"   成功率 / Success Rate: {success_rate:.1f}%")
        report_lines.append("")
        
        # 详细结果 / Detailed results
        report_lines.append("📋 详细结果 / Detailed Results:")
        report_lines.append("-" * 40)
        
        for result in self.test_results:
            status = "✅ PASS" if result.passed else "❌ FAIL"
            report_lines.append(f"{status} {result.name} ({result.execution_time:.2f}s)")
            
            if result.error:
                report_lines.append(f"      错误: {result.error}")
            
            if result.details:
                for key, value in result.details.items():
                    if isinstance(value, (int, float, bool, str)):

            report_lines.append("")
        
        # 性能统计 / Performance statistics

        return "\n".join(report_lines)

    sys.exit(0 if success else 1)
